subject.statement: Apple named John Ternus CEO and Tim Cook left the company.

summary: As of the latest reliable information up to mid‑2024, Tim Cook continued to serve as Apple’s CEO and John Ternus remained Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering; there was no announcement of Ternus becoming CEO or Cook departing.
